howto: Move the red crosshair with the mouse, your finger or the arrow keys.
Bullseye targets pop up for about a second and then vanish.
Click, tap or press Space to fire. A hit scores 100; the white centre is a HEADSHOT worth 250.
Hit 3 targets before your shots run out. Every shot you have left over adds 50.
tips: Targets appear in the middle band of the screen, so rest the crosshair there.
A target shrinks just before it disappears: fire before that.
On a phone, tapping fires exactly where you tap.
You can only fire while a target is up, so a miss never wastes a shot on empty sky.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys move the crosshair, Space fires. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a target to fire at that spot. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy: targets stay up 1.5x longer and you get 7 shots. Normal: 5 shots. Hard: targets vanish faster and you get 4 shots.

cheats.effect: Targets stay up twice as long
Shots count from twice as far off the bullseye
The crosshair locks on when it is near a target

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the result card
features.best-score-badge: SCORE and BEST under the hit counter
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: TARGETS ELIMINATED! or x/3 HITS card with score and best
